text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — Canary failure rate > 10% for service `inference-ingest` (deploy v3.14). PD: https://pd.example/INC-1234 :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: New rollout started v3.14 -> canary fraction 10% (namespace=prod, cluster=us-west-2). Logs: https://logs.example/links/abc123

sre-jen: acked. I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer impact? Any 5xx spike to user-facing routes?

eng-conor: seeing increased 502s from the r2 tokenizer path — spike aligned with canary start. Quick metric: p95 latency up and error rate ~12% on canary pods.

pm-rosa: heads-up — a handful of customers on staged tier could see timeouts, support already flagged 2 tickets, not widespread yet.

sre-jen: ok. mitigation plan: 1) divert canary traffic to previous stable 3.13 2) pause rollout 3) roll back if errors persist. Can someone run the divert?

infra-ash: running traffic diversion now -> `kubectl patch svc inference-ingest -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"rollout":"stable-3.13"}}}' -n prod` 

deploy-bot: Rollout paused (v3.14) — canary traffic halted. Canary pods marked drain.

sre-jen: thanks. monitoring dashboard: https://dashboards.example/canary-inference — watching p50/p95 and 5xx.

eng-conor: after divert, errors dropped to baseline within 60s. Tokenizer team looking at regression in new tokenizer shard init.

pm-rosa: opening communication to support + affected customers: short note queued.

sre-jen: next steps: keep canary paused, create a hotfix branch to revert tokenizer change, eng-runtime to triage root cause, if root cause not fixed within 90m we'll rollback fully. tagging @eng-runtime for full triage.

eng-conor: noted — starting bisect on the packaging change, will update in ~30m.

infra-ash: creating PD incident bridge: https://pd.example/bridge/INC-1234/bridge-id

sre-jen: handing off to night oncall in 45m unless cleared. I'll create a short runbook in the incident doc: 1) verify canary traffic = 0, 2) confirm dashboard stable, 3) escalate to eng-runtime if new 5xxs.

deploy-bot: Canary paused flag persists. If rollback requested run: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-ingest --to-revision=stable-3.13 -n prod`

eng-conor: quick note — reproducer is flaky locally, may need replicas with larger init-timeouts, pushing debug build to staging now.

sre-jen: great. marking as acknowledged, monitoring closely. Please ping here for any customer impact changes. :white_check_mark:

pm-rosa: I posted to #support with the customer note and link to PD bridge.

sre-jen: last update before handoff: traffic diverted, errors back to baseline, engineering triage in progress. If anything regresses, page PD again and tag this thread.

eng-conor: will update thread with root cause / PR link.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded by sre-jen (4891234567).
